Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR simplifies Control UI subscriptions, focus references, and post-render work while renaming the shared plugin icon owner. **Example:** Model setup advances from consent to device-code sign-in. - **Before:** The wizard finds its primary focus target with a DOM query. - **After:** The wizard focuses the registered Open sign-in element. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Useful lifecycle cleanup with supporting CI coverage, a stale generated capture, and unresolved attribution of failing checks. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored refactor is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; the body reports a production startup comparison, while CI supplies supporting harness coverage rather than direct evidence of the changed interactions. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Settings and plugin interactions must retain focus, cancellation, and view state as their Solid lifecycles are simplified. **Reason:** The supplied maintainer-authored direction authorizes this focused lifecycle cleanup, and the diff reuses existing owners without adding configuration or public APIs. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** Keep this maintainer-directed refactor open; the icon-owner rename leaves a stale generated boot manifest that needs repair. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1` ## Before merge - [ ] **Regenerate the boot manifest for the renamed icon module (P2)** - The renamed import resolves to plugin-icon-owner.ts, but ui/config/control-ui-boot-modules.json:1931 still records the deleted plugin-icon-controller.ts and contains no replacement entry. control-ui-chunking.ts selects recorded boot membership by exact module path, so the generated capture no longer describes this dependency. Regenerate the manifest with pnpm ui:boot-manifest:gen and verify grouped output with pnpm ui:build, as ui/AGENTS.md requires; do not hand-edit the generated file. The existing review at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176460#discussion_r4308674925 flags the same omission. - [ ] **Complete next step** - Attribute the remaining core-lint and real-Gateway media failures against main before landing; repair only failures caused by this diff. ## Findings - [P2] Regenerate the boot manifest for the renamed icon module — `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-tool-icon-controller.ts:6` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied startup comparison does not demonstrate settings focus, background-preview retirement, or retained plugin-view interactions.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Control UI views consume synchronous Gateway and configuration owners, then manage rendering, focus, subscriptions, and icon resources within their view lifetimes. ```mermaid flowchart TD Gateway[Gateway and configuration owners] --> Projections[Reactive projections] Projections --> Views[Settings and plugin views] Views --> Refs[Focus and DOM references] Views --> Icons[Shared plugin icon owner] Icons --> Transport[Authenticated icon transport] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the existing lifecycle owners and regenerate the boot capture to include the renamed icon module. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source inspection establishes the stale manifest entry and failed exact-path membership for the renamed module; no runtime regression was reproduced. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The owner-scoped refactor is coherent, preserves synchronous domain authority, and needs the generated boot capture updated with its renamed dependency. Full review comments: - [P2] Regenerate the boot manifest for the renamed icon module — `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-tool-icon-controller.ts:6` The renamed import resolves to plugin-icon-owner.ts, but ui/config/control-ui-boot-modules.json:1931 still records the deleted plugin-icon-controller.ts and contains no replacement entry. control-ui-chunking.ts selects recorded boot membership by exact module path, so the generated capture no longer describes this dependency. Regenerate the manifest with pnpm ui:boot-manifest:gen and verify grouped output with pnpm ui:build, as ui/AGENTS.md requires; do not hand-edit the generated file. The existing review at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176460#discussion_r4308674925 flags the same omission. Confidence: 0.96 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.88 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [993ec298df4e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/993ec298df4ee9e5a761553500c623f3c38feab6). ### Provenance checked - `Shared plugin icon lifecycle` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145644: Consolidate catalog requests while preserving consumer-specific timeout, retry, cancellation, and publication behavior.) - `Settings and model setup lifetime ownership` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173811: Move presentation lifetimes into Solid while keeping request and mutation decisions synchronous.) - `Profile drag references and page projections` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174771: Simplify view lifetimes while retaining imperative drag integration and domain authority.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm ui:boot-manifest:gen - pnpm ui:build - pnpm --dir ui test src/pages/plugins/catalog-icon-controller.test.ts - git diff --check What I checked: - **Pinned introduction:** Reviewed the introduced hunks from the verified merge base to the original PR head; unrelated base movement was excluded. ([bdab362ac59c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1)) - **Stale boot capture:** The generated manifest still contains plugin-icon-controller.ts, while the changed imports resolve plugin-icon-owner.ts; boot-group membership uses exact normalized module paths. ([`ui/config/control-ui-boot-modules.json:1931`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1/ui/config/control-ui-boot-modules.json#L1931), [bdab362ac59c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1)) - **Applicable build contract:** The UI guide requires regenerating the boot manifest for material boot-path changes and verifying grouped build output; the existing review at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176460#discussion_r4308674925 identified the same omission. ([`ui/AGENTS.md:77`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1/ui/AGENTS.md#L77), [bdab362ac59c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1)) - **Existing lifecycle intent:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145644 established shared icon ownership while preserving catalog cancellation, miss retention, and notification ordering; the renamed implementation retains those policies. ([`ui/src/pages/plugins/plugin-icon-owner.ts:35`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d5936a7bdcb85c4518648857a2211b023f6d2978/ui/src/pages/plugins/plugin-icon-owner.ts#L35), [d5936a7bdcb8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5936a7bdcb85c4518648857a2211b023f6d2978)) - **Exact-head validation:** UI unit and browser shards and control-ui-performance passed, but core lint, both real-Gateway UI shards, and the aggregate gate failed. Annotations identify line-limit and media assertions; matching base failures were not established. Full job logs redirected to a blocked artifact host, so these failures remain unattributed rather than contributor defects. ([bdab362ac59c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1)) - **Review limits and clean checkout:** Root and UI AGENTS.md were read completely; no scoped maintainer-notes directory exists. The installed Solid cheatsheet was unavailable, and one historical commit lookup encountered an unavailable promisor object. Repository Solid guidance and available history were inspected; no target code was executed and the checkout remains clean. ([`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1/AGENTS.md), [bdab362ac59c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdab362ac59c75e1571a669fa0dced170a6ec4b1)) ### PR surface Source +32, Tests 0.
